$comment: LHDN MTD computerised calculation parameters for 2026. Status: confirmed. From the official 2026 specification (updated 1 Jan 2026). Rounding details follow LHDN's calculator (see rounding.provenance).

formula.normal: stepC = trunc2([ trunc2((P - M) * R) + B - (Z + X) ] / (n + 1)); stepC = 0 if below RM10 or negative; netMTD = stepC - zakat_current - levy_current; payable = 0 if netMTD <= 0, else round up to next 5 sen
formula.P: P = [ sum(Y - K) + (Y1 - K1) + (Y2 - K2) * n + (Yt - Kt)** ] - [ D + S + Du + Su + Q*C + (sumLP + LP1) ]   (** only in additional-remuneration step 2)
additional: Step 1: P and stepC WITHOUT current-month additional remuneration (Yt = Kt = 0). stepC = trunc2(((P - M)*R + B - (Z + X)) / (n + 1)); stepC = 0 if it is below RM10 or negative. netMTD = stepC - zakat_current (NOT floored at 0). totalMtdYear = X + stepC * (n + 1), using the unrounded stepC.
Step 2: recompute P INCLUDING (Yt - Kt); K2 recomputed with Kt
Step 3: annualTax = trunc2((P - M) * R) + B, with M, R, B from the row chosen on floor(P)
Step 4: MTD_additional = trunc2(annualTax - (totalMtdYear + Z)); 0 if below RM10 (tested before rounding) or negative
Step 5: MTD payable = netMTD + MTD_additional. 0 if the sum is <= 0, otherwise round up to the next 5 sen, once, on the sum

2.label: Married, spouse not working (spouse relief claimed)

3.label: Married & spouse working, divorced, widowed, or single with adopted child

deductions.SuNote: Su applies only where the spouse deduction applies: Category 2. 0 in Category 3.

age18PlusPreTertiary.note: A-Level, certificate, matriculation or preparatory courses

age18PlusDiplomaOrDegree.note: diploma+ in Malaysia, degree+ outside Malaysia, or serving under articles or indentures; approved institution

childUnits.halfShareNote: s.48(4): two or more people entitled to the same child get 50% each, so C can be fractional. Calculator tested at under-18 only.

epf.voluntaryEpfViaTp1: LP1. Mandatory + voluntary under s.49(1)(b) <= 4,000. With no mandatory EPF, the 7,000 total needs voluntary EPF of at least 4,000; life insurance alone stays at 3,000.
epf.K1: Third Schedule amount from the EPF module, chosen by citizenship, age and wage month. Never Y1 x rate.
epf.Kt: eeTable(Y1 + Yt) - eeTable(Y1), never 11% of the bonus. 0 on gratuity, retrenchment, termination and pay in lieu of notice.
epf.engineCap: Cap K1 and Kt before computing; the calculator rejects a single EPF entry above 4,000.

rounding.intermediate: truncate to 2 decimal places (omit subsequent figures)
rounding.final: round UP to the next 5 sen (x.x1-x.x4 -> x.x5; x.x6-x.x9 -> next 10 sen), once, on the final payable amount after zakat
rules: MTD for current month: test on the truncated value BEFORE rounding; below RM10 or negative -> 0 (raw 9.97 -> 0, raw 10.00 -> 10.00)
Zakat and departure levy are deducted before the 5-sen round-up (110.00 - 50.33 = 59.67 -> 59.70)
Net MTD after zakat below RM10 and above 0 -> still deducted
No additional remuneration: net = max(0, MTD - zakat). Additional remuneration: net is not floored and offsets MTD_additional; only the final total is floored at 0 (spec E.5(ii): -5 + 32.55 = 27.55)
MTD for additional remuneration: test on the truncated value before rounding; below RM10 -> 0
Z takes the full zakat and levy of each month, in the same year only
rounding.provenance: Truncation, round-up direction, RM10 rules and the unfloored bonus-month net are printed in the 2025 and 2026 specs section E. Testing RM10 before rounding, rounding once and the unrounded Step 1[E] come from LHDN's Kalkulator PCB (2024 page only) and GPO 1/2024 Contoh 4; they carry to 2025/2026 by proxy (same wording and Table 1). Confidence medium-high.

nonResident.base: remuneration + BIK + VOLA + additional remuneration, exempt allowances excluded
nonResident.rules: truncate to 2 dp; below RM10 -> 0 (before rounding); round up to next 5 sen. No reliefs, rebates or categories.
nonResident.shortStayExemption: Sch.6 para 21 (subject to para 22): 60 days or less
nonResident.zakat: No zakat or levy rebate and no MTD offset: s.6A(1) rebates tax only for a resident individual, and the spec puts zakat terms only in the resident formulas. Take-home falls by the full zakat. A foreign employee on a contract of 182 days or more runs the resident MTD path, so netting happens during the year.

foreignWorkersContract182Days: From Aug 2017, foreign employees with a contract of 182 days or more are treated as resident for MTD.

tp1Items.relief: zakat paid other than by salary deduction (rebate)
departure levy for umrah / religious travel (rebate)

table1RowRule: Choose the row on floor(P), the whole-ringgit part of P: M < floor(P) <= next M. (P - M) * R still uses the fractional P. So P = 35,000.99 uses M 20,000 and P = 35,001.00 uses M 35,000. floorPFromExclusive and floorPTo must never be compared with raw P. Source: spec integer ranges; LHDN Kalkulator PCB 2024 page at 20,000.50, 35,000.50, 35,000.99, 35,001.00, 50,000.50, 70,000.50, 100,000.50.

remunerationClassification.$comment: Test is the payment pattern, not whether the amount is fixed. Exempt items are removed first (spec section E.9). Y2 is always equal to Y1; no override.
additionalYt: ESOS if the employee opts for MTD
remunerationClassification.overtimeSource: Kalkulator PCB form note: 'Effective from 1 January 2013, overtime is categorised as current month remuneration'; P.U.(A) 314/2013; LHDN 2024 slides p13

workerPcbPaths.$comment: PCB path by worker type. The same for 2025 and 2026; carried forward in the 2027 template. K comes from the EPF module.

statutoryEpf.K: actual payslip EPF, including the combined pension and EPF scheme

govPensionable.note: Voluntary EPF and life insurance through TP1 only

statutoryPensionable.confidence: medium: s.49(1)(b) names Act 227 officers only

domesticWorker.K: 0 unless EPF elected or the employer is a registered business
domesticWorker.note: Usually RM0 from the formula. No exemption found, but household-employer practice is unverified.
domesticWorker.foreign: resident MTD if contract >= 182 days, otherwise 30%

selfEmployed.note: Annual estimate on net business income, Form B, CP500. No K, K2, TP1 or s.77C election. LINDUNG KENDIRI gets no s.46(1)(n) relief before YA2027.

tp1ChangesFrom2025: C4(e) COVID-19 test and kit wording removed (spec section E still lists them; keep the sub-cap scope)
C8 age 12 and under plus day-care and transit centres (wider than the Act: see tax-ya2026.json childcare)
C15 adds grinder and CCTV, once per 2 YAs
